overview: OpenAI releases 722 AI‑generated math papers with formal proofs and compute details, sparking debate on research ethics.
Jump Trading deploys GPT‑6 agents to automate complex quantitative research, highlighting AI’s expanding role in finance.
Anthropic expands its Cyber Verification Program, offering tiered access to powerful models for defensive and red‑team security work.

top.title: Sharing AI progress in mathematics
top.summary: OpenAI published 722 math manuscripts, including formal Lean proofs, compute estimates and reasoning summaries, via GitHub, following advisory group guidelines to improve transparency and citation practices.

top.title: How Jump Trading is scaling quant research with ChatGPT
top.summary: Jump Trading uses GPT‑6 Astra agents to autonomously handle extensive quantitative research tasks, enabling recursive improvement and real‑time steering while managing compliance risks.

top.title: Expanding the Cyber Verification Program
top.summary: Anthropic launches an expanded Cyber Verification Program with three access tiers, granting vetted security teams reduced‑safeguard models for defensive and authorized red‑team activities.

top.title: OpenAI just dropped 700 preprints of mathematical proofs and counterexamples
top.summary: A Hacker News post highlights OpenAI’s release of 700 preprints containing AI‑generated mathematical proofs and counterexamples, drawing community attention.

top.title: OpenAI drops another batch of mathematical breakthroughs
top.summary: The Verge reports OpenAI’s batch of 722 papers solves hundreds of open math problems, includes compute metrics, and raises concerns about ethical disclosure practices.

top.title: Utah to let AI examine patients and prescribe medication without human oversight
top.summary: Utah pilots an AI‑only acne diagnosis and prescription service, initially limited and overseen by doctors, marking a first state‑level experiment in autonomous medical AI.
